column12: The median-correct constant-hazard form is used, as on the I-DXd and sac-TMT seeds. The brief's 1 - exp(-12/6.4) would give 0.847, because it treats the median as a mean. The median comes from PROC, since no endometrial PFS for Mo-Rez was found; phase 1 endometrial ORR was 67% at 4.8 mg/kg (OncLive, BEHOLD-1). Case against: endometrial responses may be more durable than in PROC, which would mean a lower rate.
